description: This Java class implements a visitor pattern to collect subject IDs with specific permissions granted on resources or sub-resources within a hierarchy, considering only granted permissions and ignoring revoked ones.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor that collects subject IDs with specific permissions granted on a resource or its sub-resources, ignoring revoked permissions.

classes.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: Inner class responsible for evaluating permissions for a specific subject ID on resource nodes.

methods.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a tree node, delegating to subject or resource node handlers based on node type.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles subject nodes, creating an evaluator for each subject.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles resource nodes, aggregating permissions for the current evaluator.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the set of subjects with the expected permissions granted.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Aggregates permissions from a resource node for a specific subject.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the subject has the expected permissions granted or revoked based on weighted permissions.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyRevoked
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively revoked for the subject.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyGranted
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively granted for the subject.
